1 Scope — Prescribes the requirements to be 
fulfilled by the cotton fabrics in order to 
qualify for wash and wear finish. 

2 Requirements 

2.1 The requirements for the various types of 
cotton fabrics for qualifying as 'wash and wear' 
shall be as given in Table 1. 

2.2 The fabrics shall be tested for the require- 
ments given in Table 1 after washing them in a 
solution containing 5 g/1 of neutral detergent 
and 2 g/1 of soda ash at 60°C for 15 minutes. 

3 Marking — The fabrics shall be marked 
with the following: 

a) Type ( see Table 1 ); 

b) Manufacturer's name, initials or trade- 
mark; 

c) The words 'Wash and Wear'; and 

d) Year of manufacture. 

3.1 BIS Standard Mark Scheme — Details 
available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



NOTE — Ibe use of the Standard Mark is governed 
by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards 
Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made there- 
under. The Standard Mark on products covered by 
ah Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they 
have been produced to comply with the require- 
ments of that standard under a well-defined system 
of inspection, testing and quality control which is 
devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the 
producer. Standard marked products are also conti- 
nuously checked by BIS for conformity to that 
standard as a further safeguard. Details of condi- 
tions under which a licence for the use of the 
Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or 
producers may be obtained from the Bureau of 
Indian Standards.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

To enhance the handle or drape of fabrics and 
to keep them free from wrinkles, it is custo- 
mary to impart a 'wash and wear' finish. A 
number of processes are available to impart 
this finish to a fabric. Hence, it becomes 
necessary to know the requirements of the 
fabric to qualify for a wash and wear finish. 
This standard specifies those requirements. 



In case of dispute, English version of this standard shall be considered authentic,
